Your Magic M. 40T order (Shop····) is paid and hasn't shipped yet. It's reserved for you and waiting on stock at our Tennessee warehouse.

I'm sorry we haven't written to you about the delay. That's on us. The factory stopped production for a while to fix a control board issue. That's fixed now, and all 300 units were built to ship out of the factory together on November 12. Once they reach the warehouse, yours ships to (address hidden) and we email you tracking that day.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
